bounds.domain: One admitted lease, two command/environment identities, three clipboard value classes, explicit/automatic expiry or process-exit cleanup, and optional removal of the bound executable.
bounds.scope: Fixed command paths and environment cannot be redirected by later PATH/display changes. A newer copy is preserved and completion erases owned secret bytes. Executable-file replacement, hostile filesystems, Windows native execution, wall-clock scheduling and arbitrary OS failures are outside this projection.

assumptions: Weak fairness of finish assumes a scheduled expiry or process-exit cleanup runs and its subprocess operations settle; it is not an OS termination or wall-clock proof.
